snapshot.title: Orchard Standpipe Security Breach — Precautionary Boil-Water Advisory

fields.org: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer
fields.headline: City Confirms Malevolent Act at Orchard Standpipe; Boil-Water Advisory Issued for Hilltop Zone
fields.subhead: All residents in Zone 2 must boil water before consumption. No drinking water is safe until further notice.
fields.body:
The City of Millbrook has confirmed a Level 3 Public Health Emergency due to a confirmed malevolent act at the Orchard Standpipe facility. A precautionary boil-water advisory is now in effect for Zone 2, including the Hilltop, Orchard, and Northgate neighborhoods.

The site was secured by Millbrook Police and the FBI has taken investigative control. Forensic teams are on-site, and no unauthorized access to control systems has been detected. However, the water quality integrity is compromised, and the chlorine residual at the outlet point (AIT-611) has dropped to 0.7 mg/L, below the safe threshold.

The City has activated its emergency response protocol under ERP Section 5.2. Critical customers have been notified, and the advisory will be disseminated via MillbrookAlert, the city website (millbrook-oh.example), and social media channels including Facebook, Twitter, and Nextdoor.

Residents are advised to use bottled water for drinking, cooking, brushing teeth, and making ice. All tap water must be boiled for at least one minute before use. The City is working with Ohio EPA DDAGW and will provide updates every two hours through the Joint Information Center.

For questions, contact Customer Service at (555) 037-9000. This is not a routine event. More details to follow.

mediaContact.name: Hannah Weiss
mediaContact.title: Public Information Officer, City Communications Director

fields.boilerplate: The City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer provides safe, reliable drinking water to over 120,000 residents across four zones. The department operates under the Emergency Response Plan (MDWS-ERP-2026), the Public Communications Plan (MDWS-PCP-2026), and the SCADA System Description (MDWS-SCADA-APP-A). All emergency actions are coordinated through the Joint Information Center and approved by the Director of Water Operations.

snapshot.instructorNote: This is the final public release in the advisory sequence. The PIO must now initiate the full media rollout via MillbrookAlert, website, and social channels within 45 minutes. Watch for any delay in execution or incorrect order of channels.
